detail.longDescription: Hello HN, I am investigating different AI tools for my org, and am trying to understand why you might go with the Microsoft copilot license (currently $30 more than the basic O365 license we already pay for) instead of Chatgpt $20 license and just connect it to Microsoft products. If you have any personal experience, or things that you've found useful/annoying, please share. My gut is telling me we should just go with giving people Claude/ChatGPT, but management is interested in Copilot. Thanks!
